latency.note: Re-measured 2026-09-11 under confirmed-clean conditions (RGB-sync/telemetry apps ASUS Aura Sync + NZXT NGenuity2Helper, GoogleDriveFS, Spotify, Chrome closed; power plan switched to High performance) for a consistent footing with the ResNet-50 FP32/INT8 re-benchmark, which found the original session ran under external system contention. This variant's original figures (median 25.46ms, p95 26.93ms) turned out close to the corrected ones -- little to no contention was present specifically during this run -- but it was re-measured anyway so all six variants share the same clean-session methodology (n_warmup=100, n_runs=1000, median of 3 repeats).
